entries.clue: Dark crumbly stuff made by letting peelings and clippings rot down
Plough beasts yoked in pairs, the tractors of the strip field
Wet fibrous stuff ground from timber, dried and rolled to make paper
Study and hoarding of stamps, done with tweezers and a magnifier
Long-handled blade skimmed through the surface to slice off unwanted growth
Craftsman who fixed goose feathers to the shaft of every arrow
Engine of twisted sinew that shot one huge bolt flat and level, never lobbing stones.
The flat green part of a plant, raked into sacks each autumn and left to rot into mould.
Something ordered online that arrives at your home in a van
Stone-hurling war engine, or a child's Y-shaped elastic toy
Bent wire loop that pinches a few loose leaves together
Rented council strip where townsfolk grow their own vegetables
